original_description: Discover agent skills from the open ecosystem and load them either permanently or for a single session. best_description: Use this whenever the user is about to do serious, unfamiliar, or high-stakes work and would rather follow a proven external playbook than your improvisation — threat modeling and security review, testing strategy, big migrations and upgrades, infra/IaC and PR review, deployment, new frameworks, SDKs, APIs, or file formats.
